description: RSI, MACD, Bollinger %B, ATR, EMA trend and volume rank for one coin on Hyperliquid's candles of the chosen interval (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h or 1d; default 15m), plus the current funding rate. Use as inputs to your own decision, e.g. 1h or 4h for the trend and 15m for timing; it is not a trading recommendation. ATR is useful for placing a stop. Not for live quotes (use compare_venue_prices) or raw prices (use get_price_candles). Inputs: symbol (base coin), interval. Prices in USD per coin. Next: size_position.

interval.description: Candle length the indicators are computed on

name: get_technical_indicators

atr.description: ATR(14) on candles of that interval, USD per coin

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

funding_rate.description: Current funding rate per interval, fraction

timestamp.description: Last candle's open time (ms since epoch)

volume_rank.description: Latest volume's percentile among recent candles, 0-1

title: Technical indicators
